title: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents have made substantial progress in domains where they have a non-trivial amount of time to deliberate between actions, such as mathematics, software engineering, and performing tasks on desktop applications. It is less clear how such models fare in settings that demand real-time interaction, such as playing a video game or operating a physical device. In these settings, the environment state may evolve as the agent is reasoning, or even as the underlying model is performing a forward pass. To gain insight into the real-time interaction capabilities of vision-language agents, we introduce Gym-Anything-RT. Our key idea is to construct visual minigames that demand a portfolio of capabilities required for interactive real-time settings. translated_title: Gym-Anything-RT：为视觉-语言智能体扩展实时交互环境
translated_abstract: AI智能体在那些它们在动作之间有充裕时间进行思考的领域（如数学、软件工程以及桌面应用程序任务执行）已取得重大进展。然而，这些模型在需要实时交互的场景（如玩电子游戏或操作物理设备）中的表现如何尚不清楚。在这些场景中，环境状态可能在智能体进行推理时、甚至在底层模型执行前向传播的过程中就发生演变。为了深入了解视觉-语言智能体的实时交互能力，我们提出了Gym-Anything-RT。我们的核心思想是构建需要多种实时交互所需能力组合的视觉小游戏。Gym-Anything-RT使用智能体流水线，基于实时交互所需的六种能力分类体系自动生成此类环境，包括感知能力等。
tldr: 提出了Gym-Anything-RT，一个基于六种实时交互能力分类体系、通过智能体流水线自动生成视觉小游戏的基准环境，用于系统评估视觉-语言智能体的实时交互能力。
